title: ETL with AWS Glue [Hands-On] - Short Version

cues.en: Hello, my friends, and welcome to this your hands-on tutorial on ETL with AWS Glue.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到使用 AWS Glue 做 ETL 的實作。

cues.en: AWS Glue is indeed the AWS service to create ETL processes, extract, transform, load.
cues.zh: AWS Glue 是 AWS 用來建立 ETL 流程的服務，也就是擷取、轉換、載入。

cues.en: And in this tutorial, I'm gonna show you a quick demo of how you can create an ETL process within AWS Glue.
cues.zh: 這堂會快速示範如何在 AWS Glue 建立 ETL 流程。

cues.en: But for those who want to dive deeper into create a real-world ETL process with real-world data, but which will of course last more than one hour,
cues.zh: 想深入，使用真實資料建立實際 ETL 流程的人，完整實作當然超過一小時，

cues.en: I highly encourage you to check out our very first lab, actually, the very first lab we gave in CloudWolf to find that you're going to the left-hand panel here,
cues.zh: 非常建議看看 CloudWolf 最早提供的第一個實驗。左側面板這裡，

cues.en: you scroll down and you will find among the resources here, live lab recordings.
cues.zh: 往下捲，資源區有 Live Lab Recordings。

cues.en: And inside them, you will find the very first lab at the bottom, AWS Glue for ETL.
cues.zh: 裡面最下方有第一個實驗，AWS Glue for ETL。

cues.en: It is an exhaustive lab, showing the full process of creating an ETL process within AWS Glue, okay?
cues.zh: 它完整展示在 AWS Glue 建立 ETL 的全部過程。

cues.en: As you can see, we extract two data sources, S3 and RDS, then we do some transformation.
cues.zh: 可以看到從兩個來源擷取，S3 與 RDS，接著轉換。

cues.en: We join them and we end up in Redshift, a data warehouse, as the target at the end of the ETL process, okay?
cues.zh: 將它們聯結，最後進入資料倉儲 Redshift，作為 ETL 目標。

cues.en: So, that's only if you want to dive deeper into ETL with AWS Glue.
cues.zh: 想深入 AWS Glue ETL，就看這個。

cues.en: And in the meantime, I'm gonna show you a quick demo of AWS Glue.
cues.zh: 目前先快速示範 AWS Glue。

cues.en: Therefore, our first step will be to go to the search bar and enter AWS Glue.
cues.zh: 第一步在搜尋列輸入 AWS Glue。

cues.en: All right, that's our service, AWS Glue, a serverless data integration service.
cues.zh: 這就是服務，AWS Glue，無伺服器資料整合服務。

cues.en: And to show you a quick demo, we can directly go to ETL jobs here, or you can also click this to expand the left-hand panel
cues.zh: 快速示範可以直接進 ETL jobs，也可按這裡展開左側面板，

cues.en: and then click here visual ETL.
cues.zh: 再選 Visual ETL。

cues.en: This will take us to the AWS Glue Studio where we'll have this nice visual of creating an extract, transform, load process, okay?
cues.zh: 會進入 AWS Glue Studio，用漂亮的視覺介面建立擷取、轉換、載入流程。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 來做吧。

cues.en: Let's click here, visual ETL, and here is the visual, okay?
cues.zh: 按 Visual ETL，這就是視覺介面。

cues.en: You will see how we will so easily create an extract, transform, load process.
cues.zh: 你會看到，建立 ETL 流程非常容易。

cues.en: So let's do the same as in the lab.
cues.zh: 和實驗一樣做。

cues.en: Let's first bring an Amazon S3 bucket as the first data source. Here it is, okay?
cues.zh: 先加入 Amazon S3 儲存貯體作為第一個資料來源，就在這裡。

cues.en: So that's our first data source.
cues.zh: 這是第一個資料來源。

cues.en: Then we're gonna bring the other data source here, which in the lab was an RDS database.
cues.zh: 再加入另一個來源，實驗中使用 RDS 資料庫。

cues.en: So here, there we go, among the sources here, here it is, relational database.
cues.zh: 在 Sources 裡，就有 Relational Database。

cues.en: This is exactly what RDS means, relational database service, okay?
cues.zh: 這正是 RDS 的意思，Relational Database Service，關聯式資料庫服務。

cues.en: So AWS Glue data catalog table with a relational database as a data source.
cues.zh: AWS Glue Data Catalog 資料表，使用關聯式資料庫作為來源。

cues.en: So let's choose this and that's our second data source, alright?
cues.zh: 選它，就是第二個來源。

cues.en: Then, on each of these data source, we can perform some transformation.
cues.zh: 接著每個資料來源都能做轉換。

cues.en: That's actually what we do in the lab.
cues.zh: 實驗裡就是這麼做。

cues.en: But here, because this is a quick demo, we won't do it.
cues.zh: 但這裡快速示範，所以不做。

cues.en: We'll directly proceed with the join action, right?
cues.zh: 直接進入 Join 動作。

cues.en: We will be joining these two data sources together to end up in the target, which will be Amazon Redshift, okay?
cues.zh: 將兩個來源聯結，再進入 Amazon Redshift 這個目標。

cues.en: So how do we join them?
cues.zh: 如何聯結？

cues.en: Well, join is actually a transform.
cues.zh: Join 其實是一種轉換。

cues.en: And so, among the transforms here, we're gonna find indeed, join, okay?
cues.zh: 所以在 Transforms 裡，找到 Join。

cues.en: So it automatically got connected to our relational database.
cues.zh: 它自動連到關聯式資料庫。

cues.en: That's not what we want.
cues.zh: 這不是想要的全部連接。

cues.en: We want to join our two data sources here and to show, it's very simple.
cues.zh: 要聯結這兩個來源，做法很簡單。

cues.en: We're gonna click this to be able to configure it.
cues.zh: 點選這裡，進行設定。

cues.en: And here, as you can see among the node parents, we only have our relational database as we can see in the diagram.
cues.zh: Node parents 目前只有關聯式資料庫，圖中也看得到。

cues.en: And so to join these two, we'll just have to add the other data source as a node parent.
cues.zh: 要聯結兩者，只需將另一個來源加入父節點。

cues.en: And so here, we're gonna click the dropdown and select Amazon S3, alright?
cues.zh: 按下拉選單，選 Amazon S3。

cues.en: And as you can see, now we have the proper join.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到正確的聯結。

cues.en: Okay, that's good.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And that's the transformation part of the extract, transform, load process.
cues.zh: 這是 ETL 的轉換部分。

cues.en: Now, we just have to do the load part left in order to load the joining of these two data sources into the target, which will be Amazon Redshift.
cues.zh: 現在只剩載入，將兩個來源聯結的結果，載入目標 Amazon Redshift。

cues.en: And to do so, very simply, we're gonna go back here to add an extra node, but this time, we're not gonna go among the sources or the transforms, of course, we're gonna go among the targets.
cues.zh: 回到這裡加入額外節點，這次不是 Sources 或 Transforms，當然是 Targets。

cues.en: And as we said, we want the target to be an Amazon Redshift data warehouse, which we'll find exactly right here.
cues.zh: 如前所述，目標要 Amazon Redshift 資料倉儲，就在這裡。

cues.en: And automatically, it got added the right way, just as we want.
cues.zh: 它自動正確加入，符合需求。

cues.en: Let's close this, and this is our final extract, transform, load process, which we created in just a few clicks.
cues.zh: 關閉這裡，這就是最後的 ETL 流程，幾次點選就建立好了。

cues.en: Of course, now, once again, if you wanna dive deeper with real-world data and real-world case study, I highly recommend checking out this first lab we did
cues.zh: 再次提醒，想用真實資料與實際案例深入研究，強烈建議看第一個實驗，

cues.en: in CloudWolf, Lab number one, AWS Glue for ETL.
cues.zh: CloudWolf Lab 1，使用 AWS Glue 進行 ETL。

cues.en: Alright, so that's it for this hands-on tutorial on ETL with AWS Glue.
cues.zh: 好，這就是 AWS Glue ETL 實作。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂實作見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
